title: Waitlist
description: Requests with no availability in priority order, automatic offers when a spot frees up, and settings.

entry.newDescription: The customer joins the queue and gets an offer when a matching spot frees up.

offer.title: Offer a spot
offer.description: {{customer}} gets an email with the link to book: the spot stays held until the deadline.
offer.help: If the customer does not reply in time, the offer expires and moves to the next in the queue.
offer.revoked: Offer revoked: the spot is free again.

settings.title: Waitlist settings
settings.description: They apply to the whole establishment.

enabled.label: Waitlist active
enabled.help: When off, no entries are accepted and no offers are sent.

public_join.label: Join from the public page
public_join.help: When nothing is available, the customer can join the waitlist from the website.

auto_offer.label: Automatic offers
auto_offer.help: When a spot frees up (cancellation, release, expiry) an offer goes to the first in the queue.

settings.summaryAuto: Automatic offers on: each offer stays valid for {{minutes}} minutes.
settings.summaryManual: Automatic offers off: offers are only sent by hand.

disabled.title: Waitlist turned off
disabled.description: No new entries are accepted and no offers are sent. Turn it back on in the settings.

remove.title: Remove from the waitlist?
remove.description: {{customer}} leaves the queue; an offer in progress is revoked.

empty.title: No entries
empty.description: Requests with no availability appear here in order of arrival.
